en.headline: Orient Overseas says third-quarter line revenue rose 45 per cent
en.dek: The carrier reported line revenue of 3.285 billion US dollars for the quarter, with the Pacific trade up nearly 72 per cent, RTHK said.
body: Orient Overseas reported third-quarter line revenue of 3.285 billion US dollars, up 45 per cent from a year earlier, RTHK reported on Friday evening.
Every trade recorded a double-digit rise. The Pacific trade, the largest source of revenue, rose nearly 72 per cent to about 1.44 billion US dollars, the broadcaster said.
Total liftings rose 9 per cent and capacity rose 3.6 per cent. The overall load factor increased 4.2 per cent, and average line revenue per teu rose 33 per cent.

For the first nine months, line revenue was up nearly 19 per cent, total liftings rose 6.5 per cent and capacity rose 4.8 per cent. Average line revenue per teu for the period was up nearly 12 per cent.

zh.headline: 東方海外第三季航線收入按年升45%
zh.dek: 公司第三季航線收入32.85億美元，太平洋航線升近72%至約14.4億美元，為最大收入來源。
body: 港台周五晚上報道，東方海外第三季航線收入32.85億美元，按年上升45%。
各航線收入都錄得雙位數升幅。太平洋航線升幅較大，按年升近72%至約14.4億美元，是最大收入來源。
上季總載貨量升9%，運載力升3.6%。整體運載率升4.2%，每個標準箱整體平均航線收入升33%。
首三季航線收入升近19%，總載貨量升6.5%，運載力升4.8%。期內每個標準箱整體平均航線收入升近12%。
